I am a partner and principal consultant at [January Advisors](https://www.januaryadvisors.com),
a data science consulting firm that works with nonprofits and local governments. I lead a
team of data scientists on research and data visualization covering housing, consumer debt,
civic engagement, and demographic change.

Much of the recent work is built from court records. Eviction and debt collection cases make
up a large share of what local civil courts actually do, and the people on the receiving end
rarely have lawyers.

Before January Advisors I co-directed research at CHILDREN AT RISK in Houston, where I led
projects on education, child care, child health, and human trafficking in Texas. Before that
I was a research associate at Pew Research Center in Washington, D.C., working on global
religious demography.
